ERROR: deslag detected verbs with nothing!

README.md has 1 verb with nothing.

This repo names what a verb did not find: write "does not find a provider", not "finds nothing". "nothing" and "none" hide the noun, so name it and negate the verb. Where the sentence has just named it, write "does not have one" or "does not do anything". Or drop the claim if it is not true. Swapping in "zero", "nil" or "an empty result" is the same sentence and does not fix it.

Do not change the config to get past this check. Only a human can tell you to do that, and I am a linter, not a human.
